question: What can DENR Region V's Catanduanes coastal-habitat assessment notice support, and what evidence is missing before its reef-fish results can be used?

sourcesReviewed.title: Coastal Habitat Assessment in Catanduanes
sourcesReviewed.provider: DENR Region V (Bicol), Conservation and Development Division / PENRO Catanduanes
sourcesReviewed.access: The direct official article URL returned HTTP 403. The official DENR Bicol news archive indexes the post at 5 May 2021; the official search-indexed article text was reviewed. No assessment report, species table, field sheet, map file or station data was located in this review.

habitats: coral reef and associated reef fish
agencyTeams: DENR Region V Coastal Resources and Foreshore Management Section, Conservation and Development Division
Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office Catanduanes technical staff
assessmentScopeAsReported.protocol: The article says the team followed DENR Biodiversity Assessment and Monitoring System (BAMS) guidelines for coastal and marine ecosystems.
assessmentScopeAsReported.programContext: Technical assistance to the local government for the DENR Coastal and Marine Ecosystems Management Program (CMEMP).

missingEvidence: No named fish taxa, per-site or per-habitat richness, abundance values, sampling dates, station descriptions, coordinates, methods details, vouchers or identification records were exposed in the accessible notice.
The notice does not establish whether all measures or species lists were published, where the technical report is archived, or whether the report/data may be reused.
Viga and Bato must remain separate waterbody/locality units; the notice does not define reef, seagrass, mangrove or municipal-water polygons.

disposition.reason: An official notice confirms a BAMS-based multi-habitat assessment but supplies no fish data table or primary records. Treat it as a focused acquisition lead only.

nextAction: Request or locate the final BAMS assessment report, raw/validated fish and habitat tables, survey date/station map, identification and voucher documentation, and reuse conditions through DENR Region V CRFMS or PENRO Catanduanes. Continue separate Catanduanes freshwater, estuary and reef/coastal source review while waiting.

sources.supports: Official DENR Region V search-indexed text for the Viga/Bato multi-habitat assessment and methods summary; direct page fetch returned HTTP 403.
Official DENR Bicol news archive identifies the notice date as 5 May 2021.
